text: On the projects I have worked with him, Michal has always shown great drive and reliability. Next to his clarity and succinctness, he puts the player first, leading to consistently great work.
author: Vincent Treder, Producer

text: I believe you are an incredibly hardworking and dedicated person who puts in as much effort to his work as his hobbies without missing a single beat. You try to make sure you are approachable for anyone to give feedback and have open conversations so you can both grow.
author: Sofie Tackenberg, Quest Designer

text: His admirable work speed makes him seem like a robot, while producing consistent high quality results. Working with Michał on INYIU was a blessing. He gave off a kind and professional atmosphere where you could grow together as a team.
author: Sofie Tackenberg, Quest Designer

text: Working with Michał is a nice and smooth experience as an artist. He is an evident communicator and is knowledgeable in a wide area outside of his specification. Which allows him to deliver exactly what you need as an Artist; clear designs with nice, easy to understand, documentation.
author: Joran Mensink, Tech Artist

text: I regard Michał as one of the best designers in our class, being able to deliver polished work in short timespans. His documentation is fantastic and he is great to work with.
author: Koen van der Meer, Level Designer
